subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should OpenClaw fix `ai.openclaw.manualupdate.*` duplicate/no-op launchd updater jobs as this issue's core bug now, or fold that behavior into the broader UI `update.run` handoff tracker?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing updater cleanup and no-op restart behavior can stop launchd jobs and alter upgrade semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Sponsor Bounded Manual-Update Fix
options.body: Broaden stale-job detection with tests, add duplicate/no-op update policy, provide a Doctor/Fix recovery path, and require live macOS launchd proof before closure.

options.title: Fold Into Update.run Tracker
options.body: Move the manualupdate job-family evidence under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85246 only if that tracker explicitly owns the manual updater loop too.

options.title: Wait For Fresh Live Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until a current-main macOS launchd repro or passing smoke narrows the remaining behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Bounded Manual-Update Fix
recommendation.body: Broaden stale-job detection with tests, add duplicate/no-op update policy, provide a Doctor/Fix recovery path, and require live macOS launchd proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest routing candidate from recent update lifecycle work and related maintainer close-condition comments.
